UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideMer: Santa marked {{survivorName}} down for {{traitName}} and a little mercy. The note on {{recipeName}} should help.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletidePro: Even a {{professionName}} needs warmth. Keep {{supplyNoun}} close and read the part on {{skillName}} first.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideGif: I wrapped this so {{openerName}} would have one honest thing left this winter. Use {{recipeName}} before it spoils.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedSeal: {{openerName}} broke the seal and {{omenNoun}} answered. {{authorName}} is not the first name it kept.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedMargi: {{authorName}} scratched {{recipeName}} in the margin and {{omenNoun}} answered. The debt moved to {{openerName}}.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_CursedPrice: The seal broke because {{traitName}} makes fools brave. Keep the page on {{skillName}} if you want to remember the price.

UI_BurdJournals_DebugSpawnLoreModeTip: Dynamic uses the built-in Mad Lib templates. Custom lets you type a note with optional dynamic tags.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugSpawnCustomNoteTip: Custom Mad Lib note for this spawned loot journal. You can use tags like {{openerName}} or {{skillNameA}}.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugSpawnCustomNoteRequ: Enter a custom lore note or switch Lore Mode back to Dynamic.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugSpawnLoreTagsTip: Show the available dynamic tags and best practices for custom Mad Lib notes.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Subti: Use these tags in custom debug notes. They resolve when the spawned loot journal first generates its lore.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Secti: These tokens are replaced when the journal is first generated. Existing save items keep their old notes.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Opene: Uses the first player who opens or unseals the journal. Best for direct mentions and regrets.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Autho: Uses the journal author's name when available. Best for signatures or remembered conversations.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Profe: Uses the profession carried on the journal profile. Best for trade-specific observations.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Survi: Uses another survivor-style name. Good for stash partners, debtors, or people the writer mentions.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Skill: Pulls from runtime-discovered skill names. Use the A/B suffixes when you want distinct skills in one note.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Trait: Pulls from runtime-discovered trait names. Keep these in lore-sensitive spots instead of generic noun slots.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Recip: Pulls from runtime-discovered journal recipes. Best for practical notes about magazines, plans, or workbenches.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Pools: Uses themed filler pools. These are good when you want variety without tying the note to journal contents.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_Secti: Short, grounded notes read best. Keep them easy to parse in the journal UI.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_TipSe: Keep notes to three sentences at most. One or two short sentences usually reads best.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_TipDi: Use {{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} when you want different values, not accidental repeats.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_TipTo: Worn journals should feel grounded, bloody journals tense, Yuletide warm, and cursed notes accusatory or ominous.
UI_BurdJournals_DebugLoreTagHelper_TipDy: The new Mad Lib note system only applies to journals spawned after this update. Existing save items stay untouched.
